notes:
Lead source: inbound trial signup -> demo request via website widget. Small/mid CX automation vendor focused on SMB helpdesks. Wants simple self-serve hosted API with low friction onboarding.

Key quotes & pain: 
- "We need concise ticket summaries for reps + structured output for CRM ingest (json schema)."
- "Tool calling to run lookups (order/status) from their platform is non-negotiable."

Technical ask (first pass):
- Workload: ticket summarization + action suggestion + tool calling hooks for 3rd-party APIs.
- Latency target: p50 < 250ms for short summaries, p95 < 800ms tolerable for longer jobs.
- Throughput: expected 20-40 reqs/sec during business hours; daily batch for overnight summarization (2M tokens/day peak during sprint).
- Cost sensitivity: SMB price-conscious; interested in cost suggestions (batching, prefix caching) and per-token estimates for trial.
- Model preference: open / quantized model recommended; willing to test Redwood curated variant. Prior experimentation with mainstream LLM APIs (slow and expensive at scale).
- Routing/fallback: want fallback to cheaper smaller model for non-critical summarization and immediate failover if latencies spike.

Security/compliance:
- SSO/SAML required for admin console.
- Audit logs & retention controls for support transcripts (30-365 days configurable).
- Data residency not required today, may revisit when expanding to EU customers.

Commercial / engagement notes:
- Signed up for free self-serve trial on 2026-02-18, used small credit to test simple prompt -> liked structured JSON outputs.
- Demo scheduled 2026-03-01 (recording: ff-20260301-emberpoint-kickoff).
- AE (Avery) ran 20-min scoping call 2026-03-05; SE (Ravi) to join POC kickoff.
- Customer asked for a sample security FAQ and short KBA on SAML + audit examples (uploaded to drive).

POC success criteria (customer):
- Automated ticket summaries reduce average reply prep time by 30%.
- Structured JSON output matches their CRM schema without downstream transforms.
- Tool-calling flow executes safely in 95% of test cases (mock APIs).

Next steps (short):
- Send trial API keys + SDK quickstart + sample prompt templates (Avery)
- SE to validate schema mapping and provide batching suggestions (Ravi)
